messages:
maria.design: quick design review — attaching a mock of the latency panel i updated. main ask: does the sampling toggle placement feel discoverable when you're in compact mode? :thinking:

sam.engineering: skimmed it, looks cleaner. worried the sampling control is still two clicks away in compact — users will try to drag the scrubber first.

jamal.pm: agree with sam. also we should spell out what sampled means in the tooltip. product folks keep asking if sampling affects p95 calc or just chart points.

maria.design: good call. current plan: tooltip copy "Sampling reduces the render density to improve responsiveness; p95 and aggregates are computed on full data unless 'sample for metrics' is enabled." thinking of two-tier copy. thoughts?

liz.accessibility: wording is slightly complex. suggest: "Sampling shows a subset of raw traces to speed up visualization. Metrics (p50/p95) always use full-data aggregates unless you enable 'Reduce metrics precision'." also the toggle needs an aria-label: `aria-label=\"Toggle chart sampling\"` so screen readers know which chart it targets.

sam.engineering: implementing aria-label is easy. on the backend we currently have a single `sampling_level` per dashboard; if we make the toggle chart-scoped we'll need an extra param. pref about scope?

maria.design: i prefer chart-scoped — people will want to sample the heatmap but keep p95 card full. maybe show a small breadcrumb: "applies to: Heatmap" under the control.

jamal.pm: important: telemetry. if we add chart-scoped sampling we need events: `sampling_toggled`, `sampling_scope`, `sampling_level`. cc @analytics. also need guardrails in docs.

sam.engineering: noted. quick dev note: adding per-chart scope will add ~30ms to panel render in our prototype due to extra diffing. we can optimize later but flagging perf hit.

maria.design: hmm. if render cost is non-trivial, what if the compact panel exposes a small inline menu (three dots) that holds per-chart sampling and advanced options so the default quick toggle stays global? keeps toolbar simple.

liz.accessibility: that could work but make sure the menu is keyboard reachable and the menu items have role=menuitemcheckbox. also keyboard shortcut would be great: `k` to open panel menu. add focus outline for the compact toolbar.

sam.engineering: keyboard shortcut maybe conflicts with other shortcuts. need to check global map. also small menu increases discoverability burden — microcopy needs to be explicit.

maria.design: mock updated: i moved the sampling into a condensed kebab menu for compact, left the full toggle on expanded. added tooltip copy variant and small breadcrumb showing scope. posted screenshot: https://tiny.redwood/mock123 :eyes:

jamal.pm: copy looks better. one microcopy nit: change "Reduce metrics precision" to "Lower metrics precision" — shorter and fits button width.

liz.accessibility: approve the aria changes. one more nit: color contrast of the p95 badge on dark heatmap. current #7a5bd3 on #121217 fails AA. propose #8f6be8 or add a subtle white outline.

sam.engineering: we'll update styles. also FYI the heatmap density slider currently clamps to 10-100; i propose 5-100 so sampling granularity can go lower for very spiky traces.

maria.design: 5-100 is fine. i'll update the slider step to 5 and add a small live value with `aria-live=polite`.

jamal.pm: timeline? think this is safe for the next interface patch unless perf proves worse. we should ship as opt-in behind feature-flag so teams can test.

sam.engineering: agree. i'll implement chart-scoped sampling behind `feature:per_chart_sampling`, add telemetry, and run perf A/B.

maria.design: thanks — i'll update the component spec, include the tooltip copy variants and accessibility checklist. tagging ux-bot to auto-create follow-up ticket. :thumbsup:

ux-bot: created ticket #4227 — "Per-chart sampling + compact menu pattern" assigned to sam.engineering, due 2024-05-03.
